comparison.objective: Stack three boxes with the heavy steel case at the bottom; candidate breaks and recovers four installed tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Stacking task tests weight-aware ordering, lifting, and stable placement; candidate tests narrow-tool alignment, bimanual striking, damage avoidance, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Case must be on the pallet mark beneath both cartons; tipping over 30 degrees or case-on-top fails. Candidate requires four damage-free fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Load-order stacking is unrelated to controlled notch fracture beyond generic manipulation.
